    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AddedEmailAddress
    The answer of POST /who/me/email-addresses/confirmations.
    AdminGate
    The checks every admin endpoint makes before it looks at anything the request names, in this order: signed out is 401; a request whose permissions lack the one needed is 403; then, for a request that changes something, the caller decides: a browser session whose sign-in is no longer recent is 401 and must sign in again; a session cookie with an API key or bearer token beside it, which the session signed in and the header did not, is 403, as is any sign-in that is neither a browser session nor a bearer token or an API key.
    AlreadyLinkedException
    The provider account belongs to another identity.
    ApiKey
    An identity's key as ApiKeyService.findByIdentity(UUID) lists it, with no secret in it.
    ApiKeyAuthenticationConverter
    Reads an API key from a request header into an ApiKeyAuthenticationToken.
    ApiKeyAuthenticationFilter
    Signs in requests that carry an API key header, through Spring Security's AuthenticationFilter: ApiKeyAuthenticationConverter reads the header and ApiKeyAuthenticationProvider resolves the key.
    ApiKeyAuthenticationProvider
    Signs in with an API key: checks the key's shape, looks it up by its hash, refuses it once expired, and resolves it to an active identity whose permissions are cut down to the key's scopes.
    ApiKeyAuthenticationToken
    An unauthenticated request to sign in with an API key, holding the raw key read from the request header.
    ApiKeyCannotManageKeysException
    A request an API key signed in, to an API-key endpoint other than /current: a key never lists, makes, rotates or revokes keys, so a leaked key cannot make itself permanent. who answers it 403 with the code api-key-cannot-manage-keys; a browser session or a bearer token may manage keys.
    ApiKeyCredential
    Credential representing an API key, stored as a SHA-256 hash.
    ApiKeyCredentialRepository
    Repository for persisting and retrieving ApiKeyCredential records.
    ApiKeyFormat
    The shape of a who API key: a prefix, 30 random base62 characters and a 6-character base62 checksum, the shape GitHub uses for its tokens.
    ApiKeyLoginMethod
    API-key sign-in as a StatelessLoginMethod: adds the ApiKeyAuthenticationFilter as WhoApiKeySecurity.apiKey(ApiKeyAuthenticationFilter) does, and matches the requests the key would sign in: the header is present and not blank, and the request is not already signed in.
    ApiKeyNotFoundException
    A request named an API key that is not one of the caller's own, or asked for the key in use by a request that no API key signed in.
    ApiKeysController
    The caller's API keys under /who/me/api-keys: GET lists them, by name, lastUsedAt null for a key that never signed in; POST with {name, lifetime, scopes} makes one (lifetime an ISO-8601 duration) and answers 201 with the raw key; POST /{id}/rotations with {overlap} (an ISO-8601 duration) replaces one, as ApiKeyService.rotate(UUID, Duration) does, and answers 201 in the same shape; DELETE /{id} revokes one, 204; GET /current answers the key that signed this request in, in the list's shape.
    ApiKeyService
    Makes, lists, rotates and revokes API keys.
    ApiKeyView
    An API key as GET /who/me/api-keys and GET /who/me/api-keys/current show it: no secret in it.
    BrowserEndpoints
    Endpoints that a module adds to every browser chain for a signed-in person, such as changing an email address.
    BrowserSessionRequiredException
    A signed-in request to an endpoint that needs a browser session on its own, made by something else: a bearer token or an API key, a session cookie with an API key or a bearer token beside it, or a sign-in no browser session loaded. who answers it 403 with the code browser-session-required.
    CallbackRegistrations
    The application's registrations, each one who signs in with sending the provider back to who's callback: <root>/oidc/callback/{registrationId}.
    ClosedSignUpPolicy
    who's default WhoSignUpPolicy: refuses every sign-up, so adding a sign-in method never lets strangers create identities until the application decides it should.
    CreatedApiKey
    An API key just made or rotated: the only answer that holds the raw key.
    CreatedInvitation
    The answer to POST /who/invitations.
    Credential
    Marker interface for credential types.
    CredentialAdded
    A credential was added to an identity.
    CredentialAlreadyLinkedException
    Thrown when the credential being enrolled is already linked to an identity.
    CredentialIdentityRepository
    Repository interface for managing the mapping between credential UUIDs and identity UUIDs.
    CredentialKind
    The kind of a credential linked to an identity.
    CredentialRemover
    Deletes one credential module's credential rows.
    CredentialRevoked
    A credential was revoked from an identity.
    EmailAddressChangedMessage
    An email telling an address that it no longer signs in, because the identity's owner (or someone with their session) made another address theirs in its place.
    EmailAddressChanges
    Adds an email address to a signed-in identity, or makes one theirs in place of another, only once the person confirms a link or code sent to it.
    EmailAddressCodeAttempt
    A typed confirmation code counted against a request: the request and the code hash to compare the typed code with.
    EmailAddressConfirmationMessage
    An email asking the person to confirm an address they asked to add to their identity, or to make their address in place of another: the link and the typed code that both confirm it.
    EmailAddressConfirmationRequested
    A signed-in identity asked at POST /who/me/email-addresses to add an email address, or to make one theirs in place of another, published once per request with what became of it.
    EmailAddressesController
    POST /who/me/email-addresses asks to add an address, or to change one (replaces), and POST /who/me/email-addresses/confirmations confirms it with the link's token or the code.
    EmailAddressRequest
    A signed-in person's request to add an email address to their identity, or to make it theirs in place of another, waiting for them to confirm the link or code sent to it.
    EmailAddressRequestOutcome
    What became of a request to add or change an email address.
    EmailAddressRequestRepository
    Stores the requests to add or change an email address, one per identity.
    EmailAddressTakenException
    Thrown when an email address is already registered.
    EmailAddressView
    One of the caller's email addresses, as GET /who/me/email-addresses lists it.
    EmailCodeAttempt
    A counted attempt at a sign-in code: the credential it belongs to and the stored code hash to compare the submitted code against.
    EmailCodeHasher
    Hashes sign-in codes with a keyed HMAC-SHA256, bound to the credential they were issued for.
    EmailCredential
    Credential representing an email address linked to an identity.
    EmailCredentialNotFoundException
    A request named an email address to replace that is not one of the caller's own.
    EmailCredentialRepository
    Storage for EmailCredentials.
    EmailCredentialService
    Registers and revokes email credentials, publishing CredentialAdded and CredentialRevoked for each change.
    EmailLinkAuthenticationProvider
    Authenticates an email sign-in, by the token from the link or by the address and the code typed by hand, then resolves its email credential to an active identity.
    EmailLinkGenerationSuccessHandler
    Answers POST /who/email/send with 202 at once and hands the real work to EmailLinkIssuer on another thread, so the response time does not reveal whether the address is known.
    EmailLinkIdentityEmails
    The addresses of who's email sign-in.
    EmailLinkIssuer
    Does the real work behind POST /who/email/send, off the request thread: looks up the address, stores the token's hash (the upsert that is also the resend limit), and sends the link.
    EmailLinkLoginMethod
    Email-link sign-in through Spring Security's oneTimeTokenLogin(), under who.base-path (POST /who/email/send, POST /who/email/sign-in by default), with who's hooks and no default pages.
    EmailLinkMessage
    A sign-in email to deliver: the link and the typed code that both complete the same sign-in.
    EmailLinkOutcome
    What EmailLinkIssuer.issue(String, String) did with a request.
    EmailLinkSettings
    Settings for email sign-in links.
    EmailLinkTokenRepository
    Storage for sign-in link tokens.
    EmailPasskeyAddedNotifier
    Emails a PasskeyAddedMessage to the identity's owner through WhoEmails.
    EmailSignInAuthenticationToken
    An unauthenticated email sign-in request carrying its EmailSignInProof, as read by JsonOneTimeTokenAuthenticationConverter and authenticated by EmailLinkAuthenticationProvider.
    EmailSignInCredentialCounter
    Counts an identity's email addresses, for the last-credential rule.
    EmailSignInProof
    What a sign-in request at POST /who/email/sign-in presents: the token from the emailed link, the address and code typed by hand, or something malformed.
    EmailSignInProof.EmailCode
    An address and the code from the email, both exactly as typed.
    EmailSignInProof.LinkToken
    The token from the emailed link.
    EmailSignInProof.Malformed
    A request that is neither a link token nor an address and code.
    EndedSessions
    The answer of DELETE /who/me/sessions?others=true.
    EndedSessionsPurged
    Records of ended or abandoned sessions were deleted.
    EnrollmentIdentityInactiveException
    Thrown when an enrollment is attempted for an identity that is not ACTIVE.
    EnrollmentToken
    An immutable enrollment token that links a Credential to a pre-existing Identity.
    EnrollmentTokenCreated
    An enrollment token was created for an identity.
    EnrollmentTokenExpiredException
    Thrown when an enrollment token has passed its expiration time.
    EnrollmentTokenNotFoundException
    Thrown when an enrollment token cannot be found.
    EnrollmentTokenNotPendingException
    Thrown when an enrollment token cannot be redeemed because it is not in PENDING status (e.g. already redeemed or revoked).
    EnrollmentTokenRepository
    Repository for persisting and retrieving EnrollmentToken instances.
    EnrollmentTokenRevoked
    An enrollment token was revoked, by request or because a newer token replaced it.
    EnrollmentTokenStatus
    Lifecycle status of an EnrollmentToken.
    FederatedCredential
    An account at an identity provider or token issuer, identified by its issuer and subject: the credential both JWT sign-in and identity-provider sign-in key on.
    FederatedCredentialRepository
    Repository for persisting and retrieving FederatedCredential records.
    FederatedCredentialService
    Service for linking issuer/subject pairs to identities and unlinking them again.
    Hmacs
    Utility methods for computing keyed message authentication codes.
    HumanCheckFailedException
    The application's human check refused a request, or could not decide it.
    HumanCheckOutcome
    What became of a human check.
    HumanCheckPerformed
    A request to a human-checked endpoint was checked, published once per such request with what became of it, before the endpoint runs.
    HumanCheckRequest
    What a WhoHumanCheck gets to decide on. who reads the request itself, so a check never sees, or consumes, the request body.
    Identifiers
    Utility methods for generating identifiers.
    IdentitiesController
    who's identity admin endpoints: GET /identities?status=&role=&email=&page=0&size=20 pages through identities, oldest first, as an IdentityPage.
    Identity
    Stable internal identity record.
    IdentityCreated
    An identity was created.
    IdentityDeactivated
    An identity was deactivated.
    IdentityDeleted
    An identity was deleted.
    IdentityEmails
    The email addresses identities sign in with, as the admin endpoints read them. who's autoconfiguration supplies one, an EmailLinkIdentityEmails, when email sign-in is on; without it the endpoints show no addresses and refuse a search by address.
    IdentityInvited
    An identity was invited by InvitationService.invite(String, Set).
    IdentityNotFoundException
    A request named an identity that does not exist, or an id that is not a UUID.
    IdentityOutranksCallerException
    A request to change an identity that holds a permission the caller does not: deactivating or reactivating it, or assigning or removing one of its roles. who's admin endpoints change only identities whose every permission, as who resolves them whatever their status, the caller holds too; for an API key, those its scopes keep.
    IdentityPage
    One page of identities, as GET /who/identities answers it.
    IdentityReactivated
    An identity was reactivated.
    IdentityRepository
    Repository interface for Identity persistence.
    IdentityRoleRepository
    Repository for managing the assignment of roles to identities.
    IdentityStatus
    Lifecycle status of an Identity.
    IdentityView
    An identity as who's admin endpoints show it.
    InMemorySessionRecordRepository
    who's record of sessions kept in memory, for tests that do not run a database.
    InsufficientUserAuthenticationException
    A bearer token whose person signed in too long ago for this action: the client must have them sign in again at the identity provider and come back with a new token. who sends the RFC 9470 step-up challenge with it, in the WWW-Authenticate header given by InsufficientUserAuthenticationException.challenge().
    InvalidAdminRequestException
    A request to an admin endpoint that who refuses as it stands: a page or size out of range, a status who does not know, a body that is not the expected JSON, or a search by email address without email sign-in.
    InvalidApiKeyRequestException
    A request to make or rotate an API key that who refuses as it stands: a body that is not the expected JSON, a lifetime or overlap that is not an ISO-8601 duration or is out of range, a blank name, or a scope the owner does not hold.
    InvalidEmailAddressConfirmationException
    A confirmation at POST /who/me/email-addresses/confirmations matched nothing: no request by this identity, an expired or used one, a wrong code, or a code with no attempts left.
    InvalidInvitationException
    An invitation who refuses as asked, before anything is created or with everything rolled back: the address is missing or is not an address, a role name is blank or names no role, or roles were asked for in an application without who-rbac.
    InvalidPasskeyRegistrationException
    A passkey registration failed verification.
    InvalidRegistrationException
    A client registration who cannot sign people in with safely.
    Invitation
    What InvitationService.invite(String, Set) did: the identity it created, which stands whatever became of the link, and what became of the sign-in link sent to it.
    InvitationMessage
    An email inviting a person to the application: the link and the typed code that both sign them in with the invited address, which is accepting the invitation.
    InvitationRoles
    Gives an invited identity its roles, for InvitationService.
    InvitationsController
    POST /invitations with {"email": "...", "roles": ["..."]} invites the address through InvitationService.invite(String, Set) and answers 201 with a CreatedInvitation; roles may be left out for none.
    InvitationService
    Invites a person by email address: creates an identity for them, signs it in with that address, gives it roles, and sends it a sign-in link in an InvitationMessage.
    IssuerValidatingIdTokenDecoderFactory
    Decodes ID tokens with Spring Security's validation plus one more check: iss must be the issuer who stores the registration's credentials under.
    JdbcApiKeyCredentialRepository
    JDBC implementation of ApiKeyCredentialRepository backed by the who_api_key_credential table.
    JdbcCredentialIdentityRepository
    JDBC implementation of CredentialIdentityRepository backed by the who_credential_identity table.
    JdbcEmailAddressRequestRepository
    JDBC implementation of EmailAddressRequestRepository on who_email_address_request.
    JdbcEmailCredentialRepository
    JDBC implementation of EmailCredentialRepository on who_email_credential.
    JdbcEmailLinkTokenRepository
    JDBC implementation of EmailLinkTokenRepository on who_email_link_token.
    JdbcEnrollmentTokenRepository
    JDBC implementation of EnrollmentTokenRepository backed by the who_enrollment_token table.
    JdbcFederatedCredentialRepository
    JDBC implementation of FederatedCredentialRepository backed by the who_federated_credential table.
    JdbcIdentityRepository
    JDBC implementation of IdentityRepository backed by the who_identity table.
    JdbcIdentityRoleRepository
    JDBC implementation of IdentityRoleRepository backed by the who_identity_role table.
    JdbcRolePermissionRepository
    JDBC implementation of RolePermissionRepository backed by the who_role_permission table.
    JdbcRoleRepository
    JDBC implementation of RoleRepository backed by the who_role table.
    JdbcSessionRecordRepository
    JDBC implementation of SessionRecordRepository backed by the who_session table.
    JdbcWhoPasskeyCredentialRepository
    JDBC implementation of Spring Security's UserCredentialRepository on who_passkey_credential.
    JdbcWhoPasskeyUserRepository
    JDBC implementation of Spring Security's PublicKeyCredentialUserEntityRepository on who_passkey_user.
    JsonAuthenticationHandlers
    Handlers for sign-in endpoints that do not redirect: a JSON answer on success, and on failure a SignInFailedException handed to the application, which formats it.
    JsonGenerateOneTimeTokenRequestResolver
    Reads {"email": "..."} from the body of POST /who/email/send.
    JsonOneTimeTokenAuthenticationConverter
    Reads the body of POST /who/email/sign-in: either {"token": "..."} from the emailed link, or {"email": "...", "code": "..."} typed by hand.
    JwtLoginMethod
    JWT sign-in as a StatelessLoginMethod: Spring Security's resource server, verifying with the application's JwtDecoder and signing in through WhoJwtAuthenticationConverter.
    LastAdminException
    A change that would leave no active identity holding WhoAdminPermissions.IDENTITIES_MANAGE: deactivating the last one, or removing the role through which the last one holds it.
    LastAdminGuard
    Keeps who's admin endpoints from leaving no active identity that holds WhoAdminPermissions.IDENTITIES_MANAGE.
    LastCredentialException
    Thrown when removing a credential would leave an identity with no way to sign in.
    LastCredentialGuard
    Keeps an identity from losing its last sign-in credential.
    LastSignInCookie
    Remembers in the browser which way someone last signed in, so the sign-in page can mark that button "Last used" and a person who forgot does not create a second account another way.
    LinkedAccountNotFoundException
    A request to unlink named an account that is not one of the caller's own.
    LinkedAccountsController
    Lists and unlinks the caller's provider accounts: GET /who/me/accounts and DELETE /who/me/accounts/{id}.
    LinkedAccountView
    One of the caller's linked provider accounts, as GET /who/me/accounts lists it.
    MessageDigests
    Utility methods for computing message digests.
    MustacheWhoEmailRenderer
    Renders who's emails from Mustache templates.
    NewApiKey
    A key just made, by ApiKeyService.create(Identity, String, Duration, Set) or ApiKeyService.rotate(UUID, Duration): the only time the raw key exists outside the caller.
    NotSignedInException
    A request needs a signed-in caller and has none.
    OidcLoginMethod
    Sign-in with Google, GitHub or any OpenID Connect provider, mounted with Spring Security's oauth2Login().
    OidcRedirects
    Where a provider sign-in sends the browser: the success URL, or the failure URL with an error code added to its query.
    OidcRuntimeHints
    Lets a native image keep a PendingSignUp, and Spring's OAuth2AuthorizationRequest that crosses the redirect to the provider, in a session store that serializes its attributes, such as Spring Session JDBC.
    OidcSignInCredentialCounter
    Counts an identity's linked provider accounts that a configured sign-in registration signs in, for the last-credential rule.
    OidcSignInHandler
    Turns a provider sign-in into a who session, or into a pending sign-up for an account who does not know.
    OidcSignUpService
    Confirms a pending sign-up through the application's WhoSignUpPolicy, or links a pending account to the identity signed in.
    OidcSignUpService.SignedUp
    A confirmed sign-up.
    OrphanedCredentialsPurged
    Credentials no longer linked to any identity were purged.
    OutgoingEmail
    A rendered email, ready for a WhoEmailSender to deliver.
    PasskeyAddedMessage
    An email telling an identity's owner that a passkey was added to their account, so one they did not add can be noticed and removed.
    PasskeyAddedNotifier
    Told after a passkey is registered, so the owner can notice a passkey they did not add.
    PasskeyCredential
    A passkey, as a who credential.
    PasskeyCredentialRemover
    The passkey module's CredentialRemover.
    PasskeyLoginMethod
    Passkey sign-in and registration with Spring Security's passkey filters, at who's URLs under who.base-path. who adds the filters itself (see PasskeyFilters) rather than calling Spring's webAuthn(), which fixes their URLs, and gives them who's collaborators: who's two repositories and the application's WebAuthnRelyingPartyOperations bean.
    PasskeyNameResolver
    Picks the name the passkey picker shows for an identity (the user entity's name and display_name).
    PasskeyNotFoundException
    A request named a passkey that is not one of the caller's own: another identity's and one that does not exist are the same answer.
    PasskeyRegistrationGuardFilter
    The answers Spring's passkey registration has no hook for.
    PasskeyRegistrationRefused
    A signed-in identity tried to add a passkey, and was refused because it signed in longer ago than the registration window allows.
    PasskeyRegistrationRefusedReason
    Why a passkey registration was refused, reported in PasskeyRegistrationRefused.
    PasskeyRuntimeHints
    Native-image reflection for passkeys: Spring Security WebAuthn's JSON model and webauthn4j's CBOR model.
    PasskeysController
    GET /who/me/passkeys lists the caller's passkeys, oldest first; DELETE /who/me/passkeys/{credentialId} removes one.
    PasskeyService
    Lists and revokes an identity's passkeys.
    PasskeySettings
    The relying party's settings, from who.passkey.*.
    PasskeySignInCredentialCounter
    Counts an identity's passkeys, for the last-credential rule.
    PasskeySummary
    A passkey as shown to its owner.
    PasskeyView
    One of the caller's passkeys, as GET /who/me/passkeys lists it.
    PasswordlessConfigurer
    Makes a browser chain safe for session sign-in, using only Spring Security's own types: Spring's SPA CSRF setup (CsrfConfigurer.spa()), 401 instead of login redirects, a logout that answers 204 and reports SignedOut, no saved requests, a no-referrer policy, and who's session-backed WhoSessionSecurityContextRepository.
    PasswordlessLoginMethod
    A way to sign in to a browser session, contributed as a bean by a credential module (email links, passkeys, ...).
    PendingSignUp
    A provider account who does not know yet, waiting in the session for the person to confirm a sign-up or a link.
    PendingSignUpFilter
    The pending sign-up endpoints: GET /who/oidc/pending describes it for the confirm page, POST /who/oidc/pending/sign-up confirms a sign-up (signed out), and POST /who/oidc/pending/link links it to the identity that started it, within the recent sign-in window.
    PendingSignUpNotFoundException
    There is no pending sign-up this browser may use: none, expired, or created for another identity.
    PendingSignUps
    Keeps the PendingSignUp in the session.
    PermissionRequiredException
    A signed-in request to an admin endpoint whose permissions lack the one it needs, such as WhoAdminPermissions.IDENTITIES_READ.
    PermissionsResolver
    Strategy for resolving permission strings for a given Identity.
    ProviderAccount
    The provider account a sign-in came back with.
    ProviderSettings
    What who.oidc.providers.<registration-id> says about one client registration.
    RbacInvitationRoles
    The InvitationRoles of who-rbac: assigns each role by name with RbacService.assignRoleByName(Identity, String).
    RbacPermissionsResolver
    A PermissionsResolver that resolves permissions by looking up the roles assigned to an identity and returning the union of all permissions granted to those roles.
    RbacService
    Management service for administering roles, permissions, and identity-role assignments.
    ReauthenticationRequiredException
    The caller signed in too long ago for this action and must sign in again.
    RecentSignInAuthorizationManager
    Grants a request whose caller signed in within a window, by the factor who stamped on their token at sign-in.
    RecentSignInDecision
    Whether a caller signed in recently enough, and, when not, how to answer: the exception to throw and, for a bearer token, the step-up challenge to send.
    RecentSignInMethodInterceptor
    Enforces @RequiresRecentSignIn on methods and types, right after Spring Security's @PreAuthorize checks, so a missing permission answers before a stale sign-in does.
    RecentSignInUnavailableException
    An action needs a recent sign-in, and the caller has no sign-in time that could ever be recent: an API key, or a bearer token without an auth_time claim.
    RequiresPermission
    Meta-annotation that expresses a @PreAuthorize hasAuthority(...) check as a named permission string.
    RequiresRecentSignIn
    The caller must have signed in recently: within who.security.recent-sign-in (10 minutes by default), or within RequiresRecentSignIn.within().
    Resolution
    The outcome of WhoService.resolveDetailed(Credential): either the resolved principal or the reason the credential did not resolve.
    Resolution.Inactive
    The credential is linked to an identity that is not active.
    Resolution.NoIdentity
    The credential is linked to an identity that does not exist.
    Resolution.NotLinked
    The credential is not linked to any identity.
    Resolution.Resolved
    The credential resolved to an active identity.
    Role
    An immutable domain record representing a named role that can be assigned to identities and granted permissions.
    RoleAlreadyExistsException
    Thrown when a role is created with a name that is already taken.
    RoleAssigned
    A role was assigned to an identity.
    RoleCreated
    A role was created.
    RoleDeleted
    A role was deleted.
    RoleGrantForbiddenException
    A request to grant a role that carries a permission the caller does not hold itself. who's admin endpoints grant only roles within the caller's own permissions; for an API key, those its scopes keep.
    RoleNotFoundException
    Thrown when a role lookup by name finds no matching role.
    RolePermissionAdded
    A permission was granted to a role.
    RolePermissionRemoved
    A permission was revoked from a role.
    RolePermissionRepository
    Repository for managing the association between roles and permission strings.
    RoleRepository
    Repository for managing Role persistence.
    RolesController
    GET /who/roles lists every role with its permissions, by name.
    RoleUnassigned
    A role was removed from an identity.
    RoleView
    A role as GET /who/roles shows it.
    Secrets
    Generates secret tokens.
    SelfDeactivationException
    A request to deactivate the identity making it: an admin cannot lock themselves out.
    SessionEnded
    An established session was ended by the system.
    SessionEndpoints
    Connects SessionsController to a browser chain: ending the caller's own session through DELETE /who/me/sessions/{id} signs the browser out with that chain's logout handlers.
    SessionEndReason
    Why an established session was ended by the system.
    SessionNotFoundException
    A request named a session that is not one of the caller's live sessions: another identity's and one that does not exist are the same answer.
    SessionRecord
    One browser sign-in, as who records it so a person can see where they are signed in and end a session from elsewhere.
    SessionRecordRepository
    Stores who's record of browser sessions.
    SessionsController
    GET /who/me/sessions lists the caller's live browser sessions; DELETE /who/me/sessions/{id} ends one; DELETE /who/me/sessions?others=true ends every one but the caller's.
    SessionView
    One of the caller's live browser sessions, as GET /who/me/sessions lists it.
    SignedOut
    A caller signed out.
    SignInCredentialCounter
    Counts one kind of sign-in credential an identity holds.
    SignInEmailRequested
    A sign-in email was requested at POST /who/email/send, published once per request by EmailLinkIssuer.issue(String, String) with what became of it.
    SignInFailed
    A sign-in attempt failed.
    SignInFailedException
    A sign-in attempt failed: a bad, expired or used token, an unknown or invalid passkey, or an inactive identity.
    SignInFailureReason
    Why a sign-in attempt failed.
    SignInMethod
    The mechanism a caller used, or attempted to use, to sign in.
    SignInRegistration
    A client registration who signs people in with, and the issuer its credentials are stored under.
    SignInRegistration.Kind
    What kind of provider a registration signs in with.
    SignInRegistrations
    The client registrations who signs people in with, each with the issuer its credentials are stored under.
    SignInSucceeded
    A sign-in succeeded: an email link, an email code or a passkey, published once the session is saved.
    SignUpDecision
    A WhoSignUpPolicy's answer.
    SignUpDecision.Allow
    Create the identity.
    SignUpDecision.Refuse
    Create nothing.
    SignUpRefusedException
    The sign-up was refused: by the application's sign-up policy, or because a who session is signed in.
    SignUpRequest
    Someone who proved a credential who does not know, asking to create an identity with it.
    SmtpWhoEmailSender
    Sends who's emails over SMTP through Spring's JavaMailSender: a text-only message, or a multipart one with the HTML as an alternative to the text when the email has HTML.
    SpringWhoEventPublisher
    Publishes who's events as Spring application events.
    StatelessEndpoints
    Endpoints that a module adds to every stateless chain for a caller signed in by a credential the request carries, such as managing the caller's API keys with a bearer token.
    StatelessLoginMethod
    A way to sign in each request by a credential it carries in a header (API keys, bearer JWTs), contributed as a bean by a credential module.
    StubOidcProvider
    A sign-in provider for tests: an OpenID Connect provider, or GitHub, on a random local port.
    TurnstileAnswer
    Cloudflare's siteverify answer about a token.
    TurnstileHumanCheck
    Cloudflare Turnstile as who's human check.
    TurnstileVerifier
    Decides whether Cloudflare's answer about a token passes a request.
    UnknownProviderException
    A link named a registration who does not sign in with.
    UnknownRoleException
    A request named a role that does not exist. who's admin endpoints assign and remove only roles the application has made.
    WhoAdminAutoConfiguration
    Registers who's admin endpoints when who-admin is on the classpath, unless who.admin.enabled=false.
    WhoAdminPermissions
    The permissions who's admin endpoints check. who defines them but grants them to no one: an application assigns them to its own roles, as it would any permission, for example with RbacService.addPermissionToRole(role, WhoAdminPermissions.IDENTITIES_READ).
    WhoApiKeyAutoConfiguration
    Registers API key beans when who-apikey is on the classpath.
    WhoApiKeySecurity
    Adds the API key filter to a Spring Security chain.
    WhoApiKeySecurity.ApiKeyConfigurer
    Configurer that places the API key filter in an HttpSecurity chain.
    WhoAuthenticationToken
    Spring Security authentication token backed by a resolved WhoPrincipal.
    WhoAutoConfiguration
    who's core autoconfiguration: WhoService, the clock, the event publisher, the schema initializer, and the JDBC and RBAC beans when those modules are on the classpath.
    WhoCaller
    Who signed a request in, as WhoSessionSecurityContextRepository.caller(HttpServletRequest, Authentication) tells it: by what signed the request in, never by which headers it carries.
    WhoCaller.Other
    A who sign-in that no browser session loaded and that is neither a bearer token nor an API key, such as one placed in the security context by the application or a test.
    WhoCaller.Session
    A browser session signed the request in, and the request presents no API key or bearer token beside the session cookie.
    WhoCaller.SessionWithForeignCredential
    A browser session signed the request in, but the request also presents an API key or a bearer token, which was ignored because the session had already signed it in.
    WhoCaller.SignedOut
    No who sign-in: the request is anonymous, or signed in by something that is not who's.
    WhoCaller.Stateless
    A bearer token or an API key signed the request in; no browser session did.
    WhoConfigurationException
    Thrown at startup when a who module is on the classpath but a setting it cannot work without is missing or unusable.
    WhoConfigurationFailureAnalyzer
    Reports a WhoConfigurationException the way Spring Boot reports its own configuration failures, so the startup output says which property is wrong and what to set.
    WhoDataSourceScriptDatabaseInitializer
    Initializes Who module database schemas by running each module's bundled DDL script against the configured DataSource.
    WhoEmail
    An email who sends, before it is rendered.
    WhoEmailAutoConfiguration
    Wires who's one email seam: a WhoEmailRenderer (who-email's Mustache renderer unless the application has its own), a WhoEmailSender (who-email-smtp's unless the application has its own), and WhoEmails when both exist.
    WhoEmailLinkAutoConfiguration
    Turns email-link sign-in on when who-email-link is on the classpath; who.email-link.enabled=false turns it off.
    WhoEmailLinkMetrics
    Counts sign-in email requests as "who.sign-in.emails", tagged outcome.
    WhoEmailMessages
    A feature's bundle of default email messages, such as its subjects under who.email.<template>.subject.
    WhoEmailModelContributor
    Adds an application's own values to an email's template model, under the name extra: for example the recipient's display name, as {{extra.displayName}}.
    WhoEmailRenderer
    Turns a WhoEmail into an OutgoingEmail: its subject, text and optional HTML.
    WhoEmailRuntimeHints
    Native-image hints for an application's email templates at the default who.email.templates location, classpath:/templates/who/email/.
    WhoEmails
    Renders and sends who's emails.
    WhoEmailSender
    Delivers a rendered email: SMTP, or a provider such as SES.
    WhoEnrollmentAutoConfiguration
    Registers enrollment beans when who-enrollment is on the classpath.
    WhoEnrollmentService
    Service for managing enrollment tokens that link credentials to identities.
    WhoErrorCode
    A failure who hands to the application, named by a stable code.
    WhoErrorResolver
    who's place in Spring MVC's exception handling; put it first among the resolvers (who's autoconfiguration does, through extendHandlerExceptionResolvers).
    WhoEvent
    A security-relevant occurrence inside who, published through WhoEventPublisher.
    WhoEventPublisher
    Publishes WhoEvents to whatever listener mechanism the host application uses.
    WhoException
    Base class for all Who framework exceptions.
    WhoExceptionHandoff
    Answers an exception raised outside Spring MVC (in a security filter, failure handler or entry point).
    WhoExceptionHandoff.Resolver
    Resolves an exception the way the application resolves its controllers' exceptions.
    WhoFederatedAutoConfiguration
    Registers the (issuer, subject) credential's repository and service when who-federated is on the classpath, which who-jwt brings.
    WhoHumanCheck
    Decides whether a request to one of who's public, costly endpoints comes from a person rather than a script: a bot check such as Cloudflare Turnstile. who checks POST /who/email/send and POST /who/email/sign-in when the application has a bean of this type, and checks nothing without one.
    WhoHumanCheckMetrics
    Counts human checks as "who.human-checks", tagged check, action and outcome.
    WhoJwtAuthenticationConverter
    Converts a Spring Security Jwt (already validated by the OAuth2 resource server) into a WhoAuthenticationToken by resolving the JWT's issuer/subject pair to a WhoPrincipal.
    WhoJwtAutoConfiguration
    Registers JWT beans when who-jwt is on the classpath.
    WhoMappingCheck
    Fails startup when who's controllers would not answer where who's sign-in filters, logout, public paths and error handling expect them: at WhoPaths.of(String).
    WhoMeController
    who's one endpoint of its own: GET /who/me tells an app who is signed in.
    WhoMeController.WhoMeResponse
    The signed-in identity.
    WhoMetrics
    Counts who's events as Micrometer meters: "who.sign-ins", "who.sign-outs", "who.sessions.ended", "who.credentials.added" and "who.credentials.revoked".
    WhoMetricsAutoConfiguration
    Counts who's events as Micrometer meters when the application has a MeterRegistry (for example, with Spring Boot Actuator).
    WhoMockMvcBrowser
    A MockMvc client that behaves like a single-page app in a browser against a chain built with WhoWebSecurity.passwordless().
    WhoOAuth2UserService
    Loads the provider's user with Spring Security's DefaultOAuth2UserService, and for GitHub adds the primary, verified email from /user/emails, which only this step can read: it has the access token.
    WhoObservations
    Runs who's own work inside a Micrometer Observation tagged with its outcome, so that a failing observation handler never changes who's answer.
    WhoOidcAutoConfiguration
    Registers provider sign-in (Google, GitHub, any OpenID Connect provider) when who-oidc is on the classpath.
    WhoOneTimeTokenService
    Spring Security OneTimeTokenService for email links.
    WhoPasskeyAuthenticationProvider
    Signs in with a passkey: verifies the assertion through the relying party, maps the verified credential to who's credential id, and resolves it to an active identity.
    WhoPasskeyAutoConfiguration
    Registers passkey beans when who-passkey is on the classpath and the application opts in by setting who.passkey.rp-id.
    WhoPaths
    Where every who endpoint lives: one root, such as /who (the default) or /auth, and each endpoint's path below it.
    WhoPrincipal
    Resolved principal placed into the security context.
    WhoProblem
    An error under who's base path, as RFC 9457 Problem Details (application/problem+json). who writes it whatever the application's own error handling does, so who's client reads one shape.
    WhoProblemRuntimeHints
    Native-image reflection for WhoProblem. who's filters and entry point write it by hand, so no controller method's signature registers it the way Spring registers a returned type.
    WhoProblems
    Builds and writes WhoProblems, who's answer to every error under its base path.
    WhoProperties
    Configuration properties for the Who identity framework.
    WhoProperties.Admin
    Properties for the who-admin module.
    WhoProperties.ApiKey
    Properties for the who-apikey module.
    WhoProperties.Email
    How who renders and sends its emails (who-email, who-email-smtp or an application's own sender).
    WhoProperties.EmailLink
    Properties for the who-email-link module.
    WhoProperties.Enrollment
    Properties for the who-enrollment module.
    WhoProperties.Jwt
    Properties for the who-jwt module.
    WhoProperties.MethodSecurity
    Properties for method security.
    WhoProperties.Oidc
    Properties for sign-in with Google, GitHub or any OpenID Connect provider (who-oidc).
    WhoProperties.Oidc.Provider
    Settings for one client registration.
    WhoProperties.Passkey
    Properties for the who-passkey module.
    WhoProperties.Security
    Properties for who's security chain.
    WhoProperties.Security.LastSignInCookie
    Settings for the cookie that remembers which way someone last signed in.
    WhoProperties.Sessions
    who's record of browser sessions, which lets a person see where they are signed in and end a session.
    WhoProperties.Turnstile
    Properties for the who-turnstile module: Cloudflare Turnstile as the human check.
    WhoPublicPathContributor
    Lets a library or an application add paths a signed-out request may reach, without replacing who's WhoPublicPaths.
    WhoPublicPaths
    The paths a signed-out request may reach: Spring Boot's error page, GET /who/sign-in, every sign-in method's own endpoints, the application's who.security.public-paths and what WhoPublicPathContributor beans add. who's default security chain permits them; an application that writes its own chain can do the same with requestMatchers(whoPublicPaths.patterns()).permitAll().
    WhoRelyingPartyOperations
    who's relying party: Spring's Webauthn4JRelyingPartyOperations, configured from PasskeySettings, with three changes.
    WhoSchemaRuntimeHints
    Native-image hints for who.initialize-schema.
    WhoSecurity
    Entry point for mounting who into a Spring Security chain the application writes itself.
    WhoSecurityConfigurer
    Mounts every who sign-in method in the application context into one chain: when there is a PasswordlessLoginMethod bean, everything WhoWebSecurity.passwordless() does for browser sessions; every StatelessLoginMethod bean, and, when the chain has CSRF protection, an exemption for the requests that one of their credentials signs in; the BrowserEndpoints beans when there is a browser method, else the StatelessEndpoints beans; a 401 for a signed-out request and a 403 for a denied one, handed to the application's exception handling.
    WhoService
    Core service that resolves a Credential to a WhoPrincipal.
    WhoSession
    What a browser session remembers about a signed-in identity: ids only.
    WhoSessionEndListener
    Ends who's record of a session when the servlet container destroys it, by invalidation or by timeout, so the list of sessions stays current.
    WhoSessionRuntimeHints
    Native-image serialization for WhoSession.
    WhoSessions
    who's record of browser sessions: one per sign-in, so a person can see where they are signed in and end a session from elsewhere, and an application can end an identity's sessions.
    WhoSessionSecurityContextRepository
    Keeps only a WhoSession (ids) in the HTTP session and re-resolves the principal from WhoService on every request, so a suspended identity, a removed role or a revoked credential takes effect immediately.
    WhoSignInFactors
    The Spring Security factor each way of signing in stands for, stamped with when the person signed in.
    WhoSignUpPolicy
    Decides whether someone who signs in with a credential who does not know may create an identity.
    WhoSpringSecurityAutoConfiguration
    Wires who into Spring Security when who-spring-security is on the classpath: the session repository, GET /who/me, the exception hand-off, and method security so that @RequiresPermission is enforced (turn it off with who.method-security.enabled=false).
    WhoStatelessConfigurer
    Mounts who's stateless sign-in methods, every StatelessLoginMethod bean (API keys, bearer JWTs), into a chain that never reads or creates a session: the security context lives in the request only, and the request's session is hidden from the whole chain, so a session cookie that another chain made signs nothing in here, and is neither given a new id nor ended.
    WhoTestSessions
    Signed-in HTTP sessions for tests.
    WhoTurnstileAutoConfiguration
    Cloudflare Turnstile as who's human check, on with the who-turnstile jar.
    WhoWebSecurity
    Entry points for applying who to a Spring Security chain.
    WhoWebSecurityAutoConfiguration
    who's default SecurityFilterChain, in place of Spring Boot's: every sign-in method on the classpath (WhoSecurity.all()), the public paths open to signed-out requests, CSRF for every request that brings a session, Actuator's health endpoint open as Boot's own chain leaves it, and every other request signed in.
